# okx-golang

> Go client for the OKX v5 API. Module github.com/kennnyz/okx-golang, package okx, Go 1.23+. REST via okx.Client, WebSocket push channels and WebSocket trading via okx.Stream.

## Construction

client := okx.NewClient(opts...)   // REST, safe for concurrent use
stream := okx.NewStream(opts...)   // WebSocket, lazy connections, auto reconnect; defer stream.Close()

Options: WithCredentials(apiKey, secretKey, passphrase), WithDemoTrading(), WithRegion(RegionGlobal|RegionEEA|RegionUS), WithRetry(n) (default 3), WithoutRateLimit(), WithRequestTTL(d), WithHTTPClient(hc), WithLogger(*slog.Logger), WithBaseURL(url), WithWebSocketURL(url), WithUserAgent(ua), WithStreamBuffer(n) (default 256), WithReconnectHook(func(url string)).

Every method takes ctx context.Context first (omitted below).

## Types

- Number: string decimal ("65000.1"). Methods Float64(), Int64(), IsZero(), String(). Build with NumberFromFloat(f), NumberFromInt(i) or a string literal.
- Time: wraps time.Time, decodes Unix-ms strings. TimeFromMillis(ms).
- Bool, Int: decode values OKX sends as strings.
- Enums: InstType (InstSpot, InstMargin, InstSwap, InstFutures, InstOption, InstAny), Side (SideBuy, SideSell), PosSide (PosSideLong, PosSideShort, PosSideNet), OrdType (OrdMarket, OrdLimit, OrdPostOnly, OrdFOK, OrdIOC, OrdOptimalLimitIOC, OrdRPI), TdMode (TdCash, TdCross, TdIsolated, TdSpotIso), MgnMode (MgnCross, MgnIsolated), OrderState (StateLive, StatePartiallyFilled, StateFilled, StateCanceled), TgtCcy (TgtBaseCcy, TgtQuoteCcy), PosMode (PosModeLongShort, PosModeNet), AlgoOrdType (AlgoConditional, AlgoOCO, AlgoTrigger, AlgoTrailing, AlgoTWAP, AlgoIceberg, AlgoChase), TriggerPxType (TriggerLast, TriggerIndex, TriggerMark), Bar (Bar1m, Bar5m, Bar15m, Bar1H, Bar4H, Bar1D, Bar1W, Bar1Dutc, ...), Account (AccountFunding "6", AccountTrading "18").
- Instrument IDs: spot "BTC-USDT", perpetual "BTC-USDT-SWAP", futures "BTC-USDT-261225", option "BTC-USD-261225-80000-C", index "BTC-USD".

## client.Market (public)

FullOrderBook(instID, depth) (OrderBook, error)        // depth ≤ 5000
Candles(CandlesRequest{InstID, Bar, After, Before, Limit}) ([]Candle, error)   // newest first, ≤ 300
HistoryCandles(CandlesRequest) ([]Candle, error)       // years of history, ≤ 100
AllHistoryCandles(CandlesRequest) iter.Seq2[Candle, error]
IndexCandles, HistoryIndexCandles, MarkPriceCandles, HistoryMarkPriceCandles(CandlesRequest) ([]Candle, error)
Trades(instID, limit) ([]Trade, error)
HistoryTrades(HistoryTradesRequest{InstID, Type, After, Before, Limit}) ([]Trade, error)
PlatformVolume24h() (PlatformVolume, error)
CallAuction(instID) (CallAuction, error)

Candle{Ts, Open, High, Low, Close, Vol, VolCcy, VolCcyQuote, Confirmed}. OrderBook{Asks, Bids []BookLevel{Px, Sz, Orders}, Ts, SeqID}. Ticker{InstID, Last, AskPx, AskSz, BidPx, BidSz, Open24h, High24h, Low24h, Vol24h, VolCcy24h, Ts}.

## client.Trade (credentials)

PlaceOrder(PlaceOrderRequest{InstID, TdMode, Side, OrdType, Sz, Px, PosSide, ClOrdID, ReduceOnly, TgtCcy, AttachAlgoOrds []AttachAlgoOrder{TpTriggerPx, TpOrdPx, SlTriggerPx, SlOrdPx}}) (OrderResult, error)
PlaceOrders([]PlaceOrderRequest) ([]OrderResult, error)       // ≤ 20, check r.Err() per item
CancelOrder(CancelOrderRequest{InstID, OrdID|ClOrdID}) (OrderResult, error)
CancelOrders([]CancelOrderRequest) ([]OrderResult, error)
AmendOrder(AmendOrderRequest{InstID, OrdID|ClOrdID, NewSz, NewPx}) (OrderResult, error)
AmendOrders([]AmendOrderRequest) ([]OrderResult, error)
ClosePosition(ClosePositionRequest{InstID, MgnMode, PosSide}) (ClosePositionResult, error)
Order(OrderRequest{InstID, OrdID|ClOrdID}) (Order, error)
PendingOrders(PendingOrdersRequest{InstType, InstID, ...}) ([]Order, error)
OrdersHistory(OrdersHistoryRequest{InstType, ...}) ([]Order, error)        // 7 days
OrdersHistoryArchive(OrdersHistoryRequest) ([]Order, error)                // 3 months
AllOrdersHistory(OrdersHistoryRequest) iter.Seq2[Order, error]
Fills(FillsRequest) ([]Fill, error)                                         // 3 days
FillsHistory(FillsRequest{InstType required}) ([]Fill, error)              // 3 months
AllFills(FillsRequest) iter.Seq2[Fill, error]
CancelAllAfter(timeout time.Duration) (CancelAllAfterResult, error)        // dead man's switch, 10s–120s, 0 disarms
PlaceAlgoOrder(PlaceAlgoOrderRequest{InstID, TdMode, Side, OrdType AlgoOrdType, Sz, ...}) (AlgoOrderResult, error)
CancelAlgoOrders([]CancelAlgoOrderRequest{InstID, AlgoID}) ([]AlgoOrderResult, error)
AmendAlgoOrder(AmendAlgoOrderRequest) (AlgoOrderResult, error)
AlgoOrder(AlgoOrderRequest{AlgoID|AlgoClOrdID}) (AlgoOrder, error)
PendingAlgoOrders(AlgoOrdersRequest{OrdType required}) ([]AlgoOrder, error)
AlgoOrdersHistory(AlgoOrdersRequest{OrdType, State|AlgoID}) ([]AlgoOrder, error)

okx.NewClientOrderID() string — random 32-char clOrdId.

## client.Asset (credentials)

Currencies(ccys...), Balances(ccys...), Transfer(TransferRequest{Ccy, Amt, From, To}), TransferState(transID), DepositAddresses(ccy), DepositHistory(DepositHistoryRequest), Withdraw(WithdrawRequest{Ccy, Amt, Dest "3"|"4", ToAddr, Chain}), CancelWithdrawal(wdID), WithdrawalHistory(WithdrawalHistoryRequest), Bills(AssetBillsRequest).

## Any endpoint

client.Do(ctx, method, path, params, &out) error — params: url.Values, map[string]string or struct with json tags (GET query) / JSON body (POST); out receives "data".
client.SyncTime(ctx) error — align signature timestamps with server time.

## Stream

Each returns (*Subscription[T], error); read sub.C, stop with sub.Unsubscribe(ctx). A slow reader never blocks the connection; messages queue until read. stream.SyncTime(ctx) aligns login timestamps (automatic on timestamp errors).
Public: Tickers(instID)→Ticker, Trades(instID)→Trade, AllTrades(instID)→Trade, Candles(instID, bar)→Candle, MarkPriceCandles(instID, bar), IndexCandles(instID, bar), OrderBook(instID, Books|Books5|BBO|BooksL2TBT|Books50L2TBT|BooksRPI)→BookUpdate, MarkPrice(instID), IndexTickers(instID), FundingRate(instID), OpenInterest(instID), PriceLimit(instID), Liquidations(instType), Instruments(instType), OptionSummary(instFamily).
Private (credentials): Account(ccy)→Balance, Positions(instType, instID)→Position, Orders(instType, instID)→Order, AlgoOrders(instType, instID)→AlgoOrder, LiquidationWarning(instType)→Position, BalanceAndPosition()→BalanceAndPosition.
Raw: Subscribe(Arg{Channel, InstType, InstFamily, InstID, Ccy}) → Subscription[Push{Arg, Action, Data json.RawMessage}].
Trading over WebSocket: PlaceOrder, PlaceOrders, CancelOrder, CancelOrders, AmendOrder, AmendOrders — same request types as REST.
Local book: var b okx.Book; err := b.Apply(update); errors.Is(err, okx.ErrBookOutOfSync) → sub.Resync(ctx); b.Synced(), b.BestBid(), b.BestAsk().

## Errors

*okx.APIError{HTTPStatus, Code, Msg, Items []ItemError{Code, Msg}}; okx.HasCode(err, "51008").
errors.Is sentinels: ErrRateLimited, ErrAuth, ErrTimestampExpired, ErrInvalidParameter, ErrInsufficientBalance, ErrOrderNotFound, ErrServiceUnavailable, ErrNoCredentials, ErrEmptyResponse, ErrStreamClosed, ErrDisconnected, ErrBookOutOfSync.
Batch results: OrderResult.Err(), AlgoOrderResult.Err().

## Behavior

- Rate limiter per endpoint (per instrument for trade endpoints) waits instead of failing.
- Retries: rate-limit and expired-timestamp for any method; network/5xx only for GET. Orders are never retried after a network error.
- Stream reconnects with backoff, re-logs in, resubscribes (each confirmed; rejected ones close their C); WithReconnectHook signals possible missed messages.
- Batch requests cost one rate-limit token per order; WebSocket trading shares the limiter and WithRequestTTL. A trade request is not retried once its TTL has passed.
